character.description: Stationary turquoise energy drink can with cream label orange lightning silver lid. Clean readable game UI illustration. Fixed slightly elevated front view showing lid. Not a character, no limbs.

open.action: Smooth one-shot can opening in TEN incremental drawings. Body and lid rim stay absolutely stationary and same dimensions across all drawings. Only silver ring-pull rotates gradually upward over frames 1 to 5; aperture opens in frame 6; connected small pale fizz expands gently in frames 7 and 8 then shrinks in 9 and 10. No body squash, no can tilting, no body vertical motion, no zoom, no text, no hands. Keep can base at identical height; leave shared headroom above lid for fizz so the body never needs rescaling.

style: Match the supplied existing can design; clean smooth non-pixel illustration. Orthographic product view, fixed silhouette, identical can body size and bottom baseline in every frame.
